items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the complexity. A simple landing page starts from 2,200 SEK / €190. A multi-page business website costs 5,000–10,000 SEK, and an advanced website with integrations costs 10,000–25,000 SEK. The first consultation is free — I'll give you an exact quote after discussing your needs.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: A simple website takes 1–2 weeks, a standard business website 2–4 weeks, and a complex project with integrations 4–6 weeks. The timeline depends on how quickly you provide content and feedback.

items.question: Do you work with clients across Sweden?
items.answer: Yes, I work fully remotely and serve clients throughout Sweden, Norway, and the EU. Location is not a barrier — all communication, delivery, and support happen online.

items.question: What is included in the free consultation?
items.answer: The free consultation lasts 30–60 minutes. We discuss your goals, current situation, and challenges. I analyse your needs and suggest practical solutions. No pressure — you get clarity on next steps with no obligations.

items.question: Do I need a CRM system?
items.answer: If you have more than 10 active clients and find yourself losing track of contacts, follow-ups, or deals — yes, a CRM will save you time and money. I work with PlanFix and Bitrix24 and handle the full setup, customisation, and training.

items.question: Do you work only with Swedish companies?
items.answer: No, I also work with companies in Norway and across the EU. I provide services in three languages — Swedish, English, and Russian — so the language is never a barrier.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: For projects: 50% upfront at the start, 50% upon delivery. For ongoing support: monthly invoicing. Payment methods include bank transfer (faktura with 30-day terms) and Swish for smaller amounts. Instalments are possible for larger projects.

items.question: What is included in post-launch support?
items.answer: Post-launch support includes updates, bug fixes, technical assistance, and small improvements. The rate is 300–800 SEK/hour, or we can agree on a monthly support package starting from 2,000 SEK/month.
